Protocol.Controller: One prototype: remove throttle prior, replace terminal yaw with existing mean yaw; best per original gas plus original134A fallback. No weights fitted.
Protocol.Preparation: For <=4 roots reuse H09 endpoint, one additional H09 coast/inverse-steering recovery forecast each. Original point forces, queue and actuator. Geometry estimates beyond H1.8 use attained offset and measured coast deceleration; reaction, actual steering travel, lateral+slip-yaw response consume available time. Relative residual-speed gate vs original134A. Uncertified estimate; no native future input.
Protocol.Actions: Original 0 / 0.318... / 1 and original steering set; only first request issued, .24s irrevocable pending, .2s reviews, +/-35deg,90deg/s, beta45deg. No native intervention, reset or suffix commitment.
Protocol.Scope: One continuous original WorldRunner through studied exit, next62m, entire NEXT bend and another62m. D1/H1 include bend3. Historical two-bend+1s gate separate.
Protocol.Allocation: 2 preflight worlds D0 A/B3s; then4 diagnostic D0/D1 A/B; commit held lock;4 confirmation H0/H1 A/B. Stop on preflight guard or CPU failure. No retuning.
Protocol.Confirmation: H families withheld from new native141 until lock; previously used137-140, not a new empirical dataset.

Cost.Meaning: Includes chooser forecasts, native world, compact summaries and historical prefix reads; audit reads counted conservatively too. Build/tests excluded: no new forecasts/worlds there.

Preflight.Meaning: Original prefix parity and physical guards plus frozen CPU gate;3s does not certify later bends.

FinalSummary.StopReason: Frozen preflight CPU gate: B mean 0.20520833333333333 CPU-s/decision > 0.200. Relative B/A 1.2236024844720497 passes <=1.5. No extra worlds, tuning, or held cases after stop.
FinalSummary.PhysicalGuards: Both 3s probes pass original track, beta45, energy, actuator, reaction/review and independent ledger/yaw-update checks. No full bend continuation certified.
FinalSummary.TimingMeaning: Process CPU, includes cold/JIT first decisions and quantized timer. This limited preflight is not a steady-state four-rider benchmark. Frozen stopping threshold retained; no repeat to obtain a better number.
FinalSummary.TargetStraightSpeedsAndFullTimes: Not measured: both probes stop inside first bend before studied exit. End speeds at equal3s are different-distance observations, not +40m or full-scope comparisons.
FinalSummary.NextStep: In a separately frozen follow-up, reduce repeated forecast-point/geometry work and establish CPU methodology before new A/B continuous next-corner runs. Keep original physics and this prototype OFF.
